- `a5-seed4-undelivered-timber.json.gz`: exact gzip of `/tmp/feudal-a5-guardrail-10b8363/seed4/final-state.json` from the first A⁵ natural autoplay guardrail run. Seed 4, tick 1,200,000, before the return-route repair; an outbound sawmill cart reaches isolated road tiles on its wall-carry path and repeatedly cancels before timber delivery. The gzip files preserve the original snapshot envelope and game state exactly. Test code extracts `game.state`; T2 and T3 modify copies explicitly as the work order permits.
